dsh-incognito is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Incognito sessions: a standalone ephemeral sub-agent with its own preset (no parent context) and full toolset, draggable floating window, burned to zero traces on close.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-f956454ecb0bcb48f94c.html
